mapper.select: select distinct p.permission_code from sys_permission p inner join sys_role_permission rp on rp.permission_id = p.id inner join sys_staff_role er on er.role_id = rp.role_id where er.staff_id = #{staffId} and er.status = 1 and p.status = 1
select count(1) from sys_staff_role where staff_id = #{staffId} and status = 1
